# Akra Dev — AkraDev Studio

> AkraDev Studio (아크라데브스튜디오) develops and operates mobile apps, games, and web and desktop tools in Seoul, South Korea.

## Products

- [Key Ddal](https://akra.kr/key-ddal/): ASMR keyboard app.
- [CallFilm](https://akra.kr/mp4-transition-pages/): recordings with on-device AI captions, phrase search and video export.
- [Stillstamp](https://akra.kr/stillstamp/): photo postcard app.
- [WAXBALL / Bubblelock](https://akra.kr/waxball/): sensory game.

Product-page publication dates in the company history are distinct from original app release dates. Concept and private projects in the gallery are labeled separately.
